The same list is on my site at [ashiwanikumar.com/certification-vouchers](https://ashiwanikumar.com/certification-vouchers). You can leave your email there and I'll let you know when a new one opens.

## Details

### Half-price AZ-900 through DataCamp

Open · DataCamp + GitHub Education · **50% off**

If you're a student, finish DataCamp's Azure Fundamentals track and they'll email you a 50% off code for AZ-900.

- **Exams:** AZ-900
- **Dates:** No fixed end date
- **Who can get it:** Students. You need the GitHub Student Developer Pack, which comes with 3 months of DataCamp Premium for free.
- **How long the voucher lasts:** The code lasts 3 to 6 months. The email tells you the exact date.

How to get it:

1. Sign up for the GitHub Student Developer Pack. GitHub will ask for proof that you're a student.
2. Inside the pack, claim the DataCamp offer. That gets you 3 months of Premium.
3. Do the Azure Fundamentals track. It's 4 courses, roughly 8 hours.
4. DataCamp emails the code, usually within 3 days. If it doesn't show up, ask their support.

[More on my site](https://ashiwanikumar.com/certification-vouchers/datacamp-az-900-50) · [GitHub Student Pack](https://education.github.com/pack) · [Azure Fundamentals track](https://www.datacamp.com/tracks/azure-fundamentals)

### Half-price PL-300 through DataCamp

Open · DataCamp + GitHub Education · **50% off**

Same deal as the AZ-900 one, but for the Power BI exam. The track is a lot longer, about 48 hours.

- **Exams:** PL-300
- **Dates:** No fixed end date
- **Who can get it:** Students. You need the GitHub Student Developer Pack, which comes with 3 months of DataCamp Premium for free.
- **How long the voucher lasts:** The code lasts 3 to 6 months. The email tells you the exact date.

How to get it:

1. Get the GitHub Student Developer Pack and claim DataCamp Premium from it.
2. Work through the Data Analyst in Power BI track. Give yourself a few weeks, it's long.
3. Use the 50% code DataCamp sends you when you book PL-300.

[More on my site](https://ashiwanikumar.com/certification-vouchers/datacamp-pl-300-50) · [GitHub Student Pack](https://education.github.com/pack) · [Microsoft Credentials](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/credentials/)

### Microsoft Virtual Training Days

Ongoing · Microsoft · **Free voucher on some events**

Free online sessions run by Microsoft. Some of the Fundamentals ones come with a free exam voucher if you attend the whole thing.

- **Exams:** AZ-900, AI-900, DP-900, SC-900
- **Dates:** No fixed end date
- **Who can get it:** Anyone can join, but not every event comes with a voucher. The event page says if it does.
- **How long the voucher lasts:** Depends on the event. Check the email you get afterwards.

How to get it:

1. Find a Fundamentals event on the Virtual Training Days page and check that it mentions a voucher.
2. Register and attend all the sessions.
3. Microsoft emails the voucher after the event.

[More on my site](https://ashiwanikumar.com/certification-vouchers/microsoft-virtual-training-days) · [Virtual Training Days](https://events.microsoft.com/en-us/mvtd)
